reason: VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B is a small ungated HF model with a documented file-based TTS inference script that can run on CPU.
goal: Install the project (pip install -e .) and run `python demo/realtime_model_inference_from_file.py --model_path microsoft/VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B --txt_path <a text file> --speaker_name Carter --device cpu --output_dir <dir>` so that it downloads the model from Hugging Face and writes a generated .wav file. It must work on CPU only with a short English text input.
check: Runs the inference script on a short English text file with speaker Carter on CPU and verifies a non-silent WAV of plausible duration is produced.
